meta.title: SkyrimNet_DOM Release Docs Guide
meta.purpose: Instructions for updating the documentation suite whenever a new release is prepared. Do not bump packaging version or ship a zip until the docs steps below are done (or explicitly skipped by the user).

doc_map.file: Full-system description in present tense. No changelog body — only a Guides link to update.md.
Short bullet list of deltas since the previous release only. Rewrite (or retitle) for each release.
How to edit/add YAML DOMSlave actions. Update when action patterns, families, or execute styles change.
How to edit character_bio / user_final_instructions / helpers. Update when prompt trees or dom_actor load rules change.
Papyrus bridge map and compile notes. Update when scripts, pipelines, or conventions change.

baseline.step: Read Makefile VERSION and fomod/info.xml Version — that is the version about to be replaced.
Diff against the previous release baseline (prefer git tag if present; else commit that set VERSION; else contents of versions/SkyrimNet_DOM <old>.zip). Note: early releases may lack a git tag.

Inventory user-facing deltas: new/changed/removed YAML under SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/config/actions/, prompts under SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet/prompts/, punishment_reason.json, Scripts/Source/, Required deps.

docs_update.step: Retitle to Updates since <previous VERSION> (or Updates in <new VERSION> if preferred — stay consistent). Replace bullets with ~5–10 short deltas only. No full feature dump. No packaging-only noise unless users must know.

Refresh Features / Required / Notes so they describe the full current system accurately. Keep Alpha tone. Keep Guides section with one-line summaries linking Actions.md, Prompts.md, Code.md, update.md. Point the Updates guide line at the new previous-version phrasing (e.g. what changed since X.Y.Z). Do not paste the changelog into README.

Update only if YAML patterns changed (families, DOM_Keys vs SkyrimNet_DOM_Actions, eligibility, punishment_reason flow, example paths). Keep copy-a-sibling workflow. Link back to README / Prompts / Code.
Update only if prompt trees, namespace rules, dom_actor load, gates, or helpers changed. Link back to README / Actions / Code.
Update only if script map, Setup/punishment pipeline, compile path, or conventions changed. Point at AGENTS.md for full rules; do not duplicate it. Link README / Actions / Prompts.

version_bump.step: Set Makefile VERSION to the new release number.
Regenerate or update fomod/info.xml Version (make release runs fomod-info.py — keep fomod-source in sync if used).
Confirm README Guides Updates line and update.md title still match the previous→new story.

package.step: Compile Papyrus if scripts changed (skyrimse.ppj / pyro). Do not modify Diary Of Mine scripts.
Run make release (or equivalent) to write versions/SkyrimNet_DOM <VERSION>.zip.
Optional: create git tag matching VERSION after the user asks for a commit/tag.

rules.item: README = standalone current system. update.md = deltas only. Guides = how-to, not changelog.
Users edit YAML and prompts — keep Actions.md and Prompts.md accurate when those surfaces change.
Do not invent APIs or action families that are not in the tree.
Do not edit this release-guide.xml unless the doc process itself changes.
Only commit / tag / push when the user explicitly requests it.

checklist.item: Diff vs previous VERSION baseline done
README.md Features / Required / Notes / Guides accurate
Actions.md / Prompts.md / Code.md updated or confirmed unchanged
Scripts compiled if needed; release zip built
